title: Pulse Terrace
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -7 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create a 128-second stereo excerpt cut from the middle of an already-playing 126 BPM melodic house chorus. On the very first beat and continuously throughout, a strong quarter-note kick, clap on beats two/four, offbeat hats, warm bass, full chord stabs and a short per-beat pluck hook all play at steady volume. The melody climbs three notes and answers with two lower notes; switch the chord inversion and answer after 64 seconds, but never reduce drums, bass or chord energy. Bright original family-friendly dance music with stable tempo and active first and last bars. No beginning or ending of a song, no intro, build, bridge, breakdown, filter sweep, fade, silence, voice, speech, samples or recognizable melody. Generate a full 180-second continuous performance so the 32-to-160-second section is a strong, stable, fully-arranged excerpt.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Stepped sound terraces rise around one open central pulse, cyan and ivory planes with a small coral beat marker; original comic-print abstraction, no city, instruments, text or characters.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz editorial panel with the stepped frequency terraces on the right and Pulse Terrace title on the left.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
art_provenance.cover_svg: Local SVG title overlay around the authored cover-art.png
